page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/eap-chat-save.md` for the full workflow. Reconcile the session state file at `.tmp/session-context.md` — read existing state, scan the conversation for TODO items not yet reflected, gather git state (`git status`, `git diff --stat`, `git log --oneline -5`, `git branch --show-current`), then overwrite the file with updated TODO items, project context, key decisions, accomplishments, git state, and active files. TODO items are the priority — write each with enough detail to act on standalone. Do not commit the file.
